item.title: as long as you promise not to make me do anything about the result
item.description:
by keya singh and ioanna loup
the body provides us a sensual experience of itself, others and the world. in return, it demands care and concern – often requiring professional intervention. with its roots in mark fisher’s texts about “the eerie”, this film explores such interventions with a focus on ophthalmology and one patient’s inner voice during those interventions. the eerie is the failure of presence and the failure of absence. and our eyes contribute to these failures.

item.title: Caring to Grow
item.description:
feat. Bajza, Jullie, Alžbeta and Lia

Each of them has a story to tell through their affection and passion for plants. This work is about memory, connections, recognition and reflection. We can always learn something from each other.The seemingly ordinary always has something special in it because of how specific each of us are.

Its suuuper exciting (!!) to see people love so deeply that it nourishes them and people around them.
The Slovak dialogues were translated by amoebadam and all the subtitling was done by Lamija Čehajić + me.
